updates.note: Management reaffirmed that EBITDA margin will remain within the 19% to 21% range for the year.
updates.quote: And with that, our annual outlook on EBITDA margin will still be within this 19% to 21%.

updates.note: Management reconfirmed the intent to operate between 4% to 5% of revenue towards marketing.
updates.quote: Otherwise, the intent is to continue operating between a 4 to 5 percentage of the revenue towards marketing.

new_promises.statement: Aim for a double-digit growth in volume for the financial year.
new_promises.quote: On the volume side, I think we still remain committed towards the goal of a double-digit growth in terms of volume for the financial year.
new_promises.speaker: Karthik Yathindra

new_promises.statement: All distributors in our network should be on DMS by end of this year or latest Q1 next year.
new_promises.quote: But the goal is by end of this year or latest first quarter of next year, all of the distributors in our network should be on DMS
new_promises.horizon: end of FY27 or Q1 FY28
new_promises.speaker: Karthik Yathindra

new_promises.statement: Consumer data platform (CDP) should be going live by the end of August.
new_promises.quote: We should be going live by the end of August.
new_promises.speaker: Karthik Yathindra
